meta.name: Purview Information Protection scanner and private Azure Files lab
meta.purpose: Optional discovery-only scanner host with local synthetic fixtures and reserved private Azure Files infrastructure; requires an existing Purview cluster/job.

resources.name: scanner-vnet, two subnets, NSG
resources.purpose: Private VM/Private Endpoint networking and explicit HTTPS egress.

resources.name: scanner Windows VM, NIC, managed disk, VM extension
resources.purpose: Windows Server Desktop Experience scanner host; no public IP; local SQL Express installed only from a pinned, hash-verified package.

resources.name: scanner managed identity
resources.purpose: Read the approved scanner app secret using an explicitly selected identity at the lab vault scope.

resources.name: dedicated scanner storage account and Azure Files share
resources.purpose: Private share infrastructure reserved for future identity-based SMB; public and shared-key access disabled; beta scanner uses local files.

resources.name: Azure Files private endpoint and private DNS
resources.purpose: Private file endpoint and DNS registration for the scanner VNet.

resources.name: RBAC Key Vault and private endpoint
resources.purpose: Store app credential without outputs; RBAC, soft delete, purge protection, and private DNS.

resources.name: least-scope scanner role assignments
resources.purpose: Key Vault Secrets User access scoped to the lab vault; no storage-key operator grant.
